scope: Numerical bounds for the discrete midpoint equations. Fixed commitment bounds restrict the feasible set. Acceptance additionally requires finer replay. No full SHOP parity claimed.
method: The frozen controls are shared across variants of each case. Two-hour baseline and tightened pairs repeat twice in alternating order; other measurements run once. Compilation warmups, seed preparation and independent fixed-commitment probes are excluded from scored total_seconds and reported separately. The probe never updates the submitted seed.
notes: Scored operating variants use explicit formulation arguments. Source fingerprints differ after the default and its documentation were restored; the graph equations are unchanged. Interrupted seasonal measurements are retained with timing_usable=false.
source_hash_method: SHA256 of concatenated sorted src/*.jl contents
